people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.
translations.bsb: He will afflict you again with all the diseases you dreaded in Egypt, and they will cling to you.
translations.kjv: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave
translations.asv: And he will bring upon thee again all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
